data.title: Team up with a writer
paragraphs: One writer who learns your brand and stays with it, taking as many requests and revisions as you need. Blog posts, SEO and answer-engine content, and website copy, produced on a cadence you set.
There is no minimum commitment, so the way to find out whether this works for you is to start and stop if it does not.

items.label: What you get
items.value: A dedicated writer assigned to your brand, unlimited requests and revisions, topic development, image curation, and publishing straight to your blog. The writer is a person, and they stay the same person.

items.label: Best for
items.value: Teams who need a steady flow of writing and do not have a writer on staff. Marketers who keep pushing content down the list because there is nobody to hand it to.

items.label: Not for
items.value: Anyone who wants software that generates drafts. If speed at the lowest possible cost is the goal, a model will beat us and we would rather tell you now.

items.label: What it costs
items.value: Pricing is public and lives on the pricing page, so you can size this before you talk to anybody.

data.title: How working with a Content Cucumber writer works
data.label: How it works
data.heading: Creative marketing made easy
paragraphs: The short version of how the engagement runs, from the first brief to work landing on your blog.

data.title: What every plan includes
data.subtitle: The same inclusions at every level. What changes between plans is volume, not what you get.

items.title: A dedicated writer
items.text: One writer assigned to your brand who learns how you sound and stays with the account rather than rotating.

items.title: Unlimited requests and revisions
items.text: Ask for as much as you need and send it back as many times as it takes. There is no per-revision meter running.

items.title: Topic development
items.text: You do not have to arrive with a list. We build the topic plan and you approve it.

items.title: Written to be found
items.text: Search and answer-engine practice built into the writing rather than bolted on after, so the page has a reason to be cited.

items.title: Image curation
items.text: Images sourced and licensed for every piece, so nothing ships with an empty slot at the top.

items.title: Published for you
items.text: Work goes straight onto your blog if you want it to, so the last step does not sit in somebody's queue.

data.title: How it works
data.subtitle: Four steps, and you keep the same writer through all of them.

steps.title: Tell us about your brand
steps.text: We read what you already publish so the writing moves toward your voice rather than ours.

steps.title: We assign your writer
steps.text: One person, matched to your subject, who stays with the account.

steps.title: Request what you need
steps.text: Send requests as they come up. Topic development is included, so an empty list is not a blocker.

steps.title: Review and publish
steps.text: Revise as many times as you want, and we will publish it for you when you are happy.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Pricing is public. Plans and what sits in each one are on the pricing page, so you can size this without talking to a salesperson first.

items.question: Is there a minimum commitment?
items.answer: No. You can stop whenever it stops being worth it, and that is the test of whether a writing service is working.

items.question: Do I get the same writer every time?
items.answer: Yes. That is the point of the model. A writer who has been with your brand for a while stops needing to be told the same things.

items.question: Does AI write any of it?
items.answer: For research and checking, yes. For the writing, no. A model cannot supply a position it does not hold or a detail it has never encountered.

items.question: What if I do not like a draft?
items.answer: Send it back. Revisions are unlimited and nobody is counting them.

items.question: How do we start?
items.answer: Tell us what you need written. We will read what you already publish before we reply.
